title: `max-len` conflicts with `no-func-assign` and cause crash

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
**Update**

As reported by @btmills in https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/1224#issuecomment-54806526 , problem is that my configs enable `max-len` rule, and it conflicts with `no-func-assign`.

Minimal example by @lo1tuma https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/1224#issuecomment-54808105:
- eslintrc

```
{
     "env": {
         "node": true
     },
     "rules": {
         "no-func-assign": 2,
         "max-len": [2, 120]
     }
}
```
- foo.js

```
// blank line here
var foo = module.exports = {};
```
- run eslint foo.js

---

How to reproduce: 
- clone https://github.com/nodeca/eslint-plugin-nodeca
- in `.eslintrc` delete line with `no-func-assign: 0`
- npm install
- npm test

